findings.title: Pod's DNS settings are more than a resolver reads
findings.cause: the kubelet cut the pod's resolv.conf short: with the cluster's, the node's and the pod's own search domains together it would have more than the 32 search domains a resolver reads, so it kept the first 32 and dropped team29.corp.example.com, team30.corp.example.com, team31.corp.example.com, team32.corp.example.com of the pod's dnsConfig, so a short name that only they would complete does not resolve; Deployment web has 1 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Search Line limits were exceeded, some search paths have been omitted, the applied search line is: kd-dns-search-line-too-long.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local q1dgkpax044ebjlqqxvb14ao4g.dx.internal.cloudapp.net team1.corp.example.com team2.corp.example.com team3.corp.example.com team4.corp.example.com team5.corp.example.com team6.corp.example.com team7.corp.example.com team8.corp.example.com team9.corp.example.com team10.corp.example.com team11.corp.example.com team12.corp.example.com team13.corp.example.com team14.corp.example.com team15.corp.example.com team16.corp.example.com team17.corp.example.com team18.corp.example.com team19.corp.example.com team20.corp.example.com team21.corp.example.com team22.corp.example.com team23.corp.example.com team24.corp.example.com team25.corp.example.com team26.corp.example.com team27.corp.example.com team28.corp.example.com

evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-7c5f899578-mhvs2 -n kd-dns-search-line-too-long -o jsonpath='{.spec.dnsPolicy}{" "}{.spec.dnsConfig}'

findings.fix: Give the pod fewer search domains in dnsConfig, or trim the node's resolv.conf (the kubelet's --resolv-conf); or use fully qualified names (ending in a dot) for the hosts in the dropped domains.
